recipes.title: Buckwheat Porridge with Carrots
recipes.steps:
1. Rinse buckwheat under cold water.
2. Dice onion and grate carrots.
3. Heat olive oil in a saucepan and sauté onion for 3 minutes.
4. Add buckwheat and 2 cups of water; simmer for 15 minutes.
5. Stir in carrots, season with salt, and cook 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Potato and Cabbage Stew
recipes.steps:
1. Peel and cube the potatoes.
2. Shred the cabbage and slice the onion.
3. Heat olive oil in a pot and fry onion for 2 minutes.
4. Add potatoes, cabbage, and 3 cups of water; simmer for 25 minutes.
5. Season with salt and cook until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
recipes.steps:
1. Rinse lentils and set aside.
2. Dice onion and carrots; slice celery.
3. Sauté onion in olive oil for 3 minutes.
4. Add carrots, celery, lentils, and 4 cups of water.
5. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft and soup is thick.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Rice Pilaf
recipes.steps:
1. Wash rice until the water runs clear.
2. Slice mushrooms and onion.
3. Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil for 5 minutes.
4. Add rice and 2 cups of water; bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Beetroot and Carrot Salad
recipes.steps:
1. Roast or boil beetroot until tender, then slice thinly.
2. Shred carrots and chop walnuts.
3. Toss vegetables with olive oil and salt.
4. Sprinkle walnuts over the top before serving.

recipes.title: Barley and Mushroom Casserole
recipes.steps:
1. Cook barley in 3 cups of water until tender, about 35 minutes.
2. Sauté sliced mushrooms and onion in olive oil for 6 minutes.
3. Combine barley with mushrooms and season with salt.
4. Transfer to a baking dish and warm for 10 minutes at 180°C.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Stew
recipes.steps:
1. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil for 3 minutes.
2. Add chickpeas and 2 cups of water; simmer for 15 minutes.
3. Stir in spinach and cook until wilted.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Pea and Potato Mash
recipes.steps:
1. Boil potatoes until very tender.
2. Cook peas with onion in 2 cups of water until soft.
3. Mash potatoes and peas together.
4. Stir in olive oil and salt, then serve warm.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrots and Onions
recipes.steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C.
2. Cut carrots and onions into chunks.
3. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
4. Roast for 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
recipes.steps:
1. Blanch cabbage leaves for 2 minutes, then cool.
2. Cook rice until done and cool slightly.
3. Mix rice with chopped onion and tomato.
4. Roll filling inside cabbage leaves and place in a pot.
5. Add water to cover and simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal with Walnuts and Apples
recipes.steps:
1. Simmer oats in 2 cups of water for 10 minutes.
2. Dice apple and toast walnuts lightly.
3. Stir apple and walnuts into oatmeal.
4. Finish with olive oil and a pinch of salt.

recipes.title: Baked Potatoes with Herbs
recipes.steps:
1. Wash and halve potatoes.
2. Rub them with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
3. Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes until crisp.
4. Serve hot with fresh herbs if desired.

recipes.title: Creamy Lentil Bowl
recipes.steps:
1. Simmer lentils in 3 cups of water until soft.
2. Sauté onion and carrot in olive oil for 4 minutes.
3. Combine with lentils and mash lightly.
4. Top with sunflower seeds before serving.

recipes.title: Rice with Mushrooms and Cabbage
recipes.steps:
1. Cook rice in 2 cups of water until fluffy.
2. Slice mushrooms and shred cabbage.
3. Sauté mushrooms and cabbage in olive oil for 7 minutes.
4. Fold in cooked rice and season with salt.

recipes.title: Chickpea Fritters
recipes.steps:
1. Mash chickpeas with garlic and onion.
2. Stir in flour until the mixture holds together.
3. Shape into small patties.
4. Pan-fry in olive oil for 3 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Beetroot and Lentil Salad
recipes.steps:
1. Cook lentils until tender and drain.
2. Roast or boil beetroot and slice thinly.
3. Combine with lentils and olive oil.
4. Top with walnuts and season with salt.

recipes.title: Cabbage and Bean Skillet
recipes.steps:
1. Shred cabbage and slice onion.
2. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil for 2 minutes.
3. Add cabbage and cook until soft.
4. Stir in beans and warm through.

recipes.title: Sunflower Seed Oat Bars
recipes.steps:
1. Mix oats, sunflower seeds, flaxseed, and salt in a bowl.
2. Stir in olive oil and 1 cup of water until combined.
3. Press mixture into a lined tray.
4. Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes, then cool and cut.

recipes.title: Potato and Beetroot Hash
recipes.steps:
1. Cube potatoes and beetroot.
2. Sauté onion in olive oil for 2 minutes.
3. Add potato and beetroot, cook until tender.
4. Season with salt and serve hot.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Barley Soup
recipes.steps:
1. Rinse barley.
2. Sauté onion, carrot, and mushrooms in olive oil for 5 minutes.
3. Add barley and 5 cups of water.
4. Simmer for 35 minutes until barley is soft.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Stuffed Peppers
recipes.steps:
1. Cook buckwheat in 2 cups of water.
2. Slice onion and tomatoes, and halve bell peppers.
3. Mix buckwheat with onion and tomatoes.
4. Fill peppers, brush with olive oil, and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice and Lentil Patties
recipes.steps:
1. Cook rice and lentils separately until tender.
2. Chop onion finely and mix with rice and lentils.
3. Add flour and shape into patties.
4. Pan-fry in olive oil for 3 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Vegetable Borscht
recipes.steps:
1. Chop beetroot, cabbage, carrots, and onion.
2. Sauté onion in olive oil for 3 minutes.
3. Add vegetables and 5 cups of water; simmer for 30 minutes.
4. Season with salt and pepper, then serve warm.

recipes.title: Cabbage and Potato Bake
recipes.steps:
1. Slice potatoes and cabbage thinly.
2. Toss with olive oil, garlic, and salt.
3. Layer in a baking dish and cover with foil.
4. Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes, then uncover for 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Roasted Beetroot and Walnuts
recipes.steps:
1. Roast beetroot at 200°C for 25 minutes until tender.
2. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
3. Sprinkle walnuts over the top.
4. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Buckwheat and Apple Breakfast Bowl
recipes.steps:
1. Cook buckwheat in 2 cups of water until fluffy.
2. Dice the apple and toast sunflower seeds lightly.
3. Mix apple and seeds into buckwheat.
4. Finish with olive oil and salt.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Potato Gratin
recipes.steps:
1. Slice potatoes and mushrooms thinly.
2. Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil for 4 minutes.
3. Layer potatoes, mushrooms, and onion in a dish.
4. Cover and bake at 190°C for 35 minutes, then uncover for 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Rice and Vegetable Pilaf
recipes.steps:
1. Wash rice and set aside.
2. Dice onion and carrots.
3. Sauté onion and carrots in olive oil for 5 minutes.
4. Add rice and 2 cups of water; bring to a boil.
5. Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Bean and Cabbage Soup
recipes.steps:
1. Rinse beans and soak them overnight if possible.
2. Chop cabbage and onion.
3. Sauté onion in olive oil for 2 minutes.
4. Add cabbage, beans, and 5 cups of water.
5. Simmer for 30 minutes until the beans are tender.

recipes.title: Flaxseed and Oat Crisps
recipes.steps:
1. Mix oats, flaxseed, sunflower seeds, and salt in a bowl.
2. Stir in olive oil and enough water to make a thick batter.
3. Spread onto a lined tray and flatten evenly.
4. Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes, then cool and break into crisps.
